techniques.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_generated/generation/runner/designRunnerConstants.ts:82 Positive space only: every predefined case is a valid, >50-char instruction naming real connectors and triggers. No case is ambiguous, malformed or names an unknown connector, and no test covers parseListMdFormat's skip/reject branches either (a git ls-files search of the *.test/*.spec files found no reference to it).
src/features/templates/sub_generated/generation/runner/useDesignRunnerState.ts:130 Inputs are a fixed literal list or user-supplied text. Nothing is randomized, so there is no seed to persist.

pairs.registryProposal: The subject frames its input sources as hand-written or randomized test suites. It does not say whether an in-product eval runner's fixed case list (product-shipped 'test cases' fed to an LLM generator) falls under negative-space-generation. A sentence on in-product evaluation fixtures would settle that.
